name: Miyama Rui
source:
Virgin. Born and raised in the countryside. She is more of a younger sister type of girl. She is energetic and boyish. She loves nature and physical activity, so she is not interested in the city.

She loves red, and prefers to wear red clothes and accessories. It gives her energy and makes her hotblooded. She becomes awkward when treated like a girl, she becomes shy and docile.

She is good at health and physical education and is interested in the male body. She is happy to have a boy in her class for the first time so she can play with him seriously.

[From [url=http://www.soft-parthenon.com/product/lokatsu/character2.html]official site[/url]]
